Subject: Follow-up: procurement intake & next steps for Redwood trial

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and asks so we can get your trial and procurement moving: 

- Summary: Orion is interested in a 3-week pilot of Redwood inference for low-latency customer routing. We covered expected throughput (peak 120 rps), data handling, and SSO requirements.
- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement prefers PO-based payment but may use card for small pilots — can you confirm which we'll use for this engagement?
- Vendor setup: I’ve attached our vendor setup packet (stub) — will you need a completed W-9 or W-8? Please also confirm where we should upload vendor docs (vendor portal link or email to procurement).
- Banking details: if PO preferred, procurement usually requires bank details + vendor name on file. Happy to provide a masked bank details sheet or route via DocuSign if preferred.

Next steps I propose: 1) confirm PO vs card, 2) procurement contact / portal link, 3) list of required documents and any internal vendor code you need.

Attaching: redwood_vendor_setup_packet_v1.pdf (vendor packet stub)

Thanks — I’ll loop in our sales ops to push docs through once you confirm.

Best,
Dylan Brooks

Hi Dylan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming procurement asks below and a few notes: 

- PO vs card: Our standard for new vendors > $10k is PO. Pilot looks like it will be PO-based.
- Required docs: completed vendor setup form, W-9 (we need a U.S. W-9), banking details (for EFT/Wire), and a copy of your standard MSA if available.
- Portal: We use Coupa as our vendor portal. I’ll open a vendor invitation but you can also email the docs to procurement@orionfinance.com if easier.
- Timeline: If we get the packet + W-9 + bank info this week, we can issue a PO next week and start provisioning.

Attaching procurement guidelines for vendors (see note). I don’t need DocuSign for the bank info — a masked spreadsheet is fine as a first pass.

Cheers,
Sarah Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | Orion Finance
sarah.lee@orionfinance.com
